skill.summary: AI-optimized web search via Tavily API. Returns concise, relevant results for AI agents.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Tavily Search skill.

- Provides AI-optimized web search via the Tavily API, returning concise and relevant results.
- Supports adjustable result count, advanced "deep" search, topic selection (general/news), and news time filtering.
- Enables content extraction from URLs.
- Requires a Tavily API key for use.
- Designed for use by AI agents to fetch clean search results efficiently.
